lines.text: Many learners say: I follow an English course.
Better: I take an English course.
Takes! She takes a cooking class.

native.tip: Kita bilang “mengikuti kursus”, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai take a course.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I follow an English course.” 😅 Untuk kursus, pakai take: “I take an English course.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “takes”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I take an English course.” Lalu sebut kursus lain yang kamu mau. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “mengikuti kursus”, but English uses take a course.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I follow an English course.” 😅 For a course, use take: “I take an English course.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
